summary: All 6 requested scenarios PASS after a small blocking-bug fix. Initial run crashed on /pair with 'ReferenceError: Cannot access persistMember before initialization' (pair.tsx line 56: `void persistMember;` referenced the const before its declaration on line 58). Removed the dead 3-line block; /pair now renders correctly. Verified: (1) With localStorage.clear() the /pair screen shows testID pair-identity-missing + pair-goto-identify, no member-id-input, no pair-host-button/pair-join-mode-button, no 'Auto-generated' hint; tapping pair-goto-identify navigates to /identify. (2) With identity seeded (2314 Alex Nguyen), testID pair-identity-card renders text 'YOU ARE PLAYING AS / Alex Nguyen / Member ID #2314 · HCP 12.4 / Not you? Change', plus pair-change-identity, pair-host-button, pair-join-mode-button all visible, pair-identity-missing absent. (3) Tapping pair-host-button created session 656810 and after joining as devB member_id 3856, GET /api/sessions/{id}.players[0].member_id === '2314' (host role) and players[1].member_id === '3856' (guest). (4) /pair-round with mocked Members webhook: player-row text = 'ALEX NG (#2314)' and marker-row text = 'ALEX NE (#3856)' — disambiguated first names working. (5) /round stepper dims measured at 56x56 px and value fontSize 48px; +/- steppers increment/decrement Score and Putts correctly (0→6→5, 0→3). (6) 'Auto-generated for now. Real IDs later.' string is not present anywhere on /pair.

critical_code_review_comments: pair.tsx previously contained a dead-code artifact (`void persistMember;` + no-op const) that crashed the screen. Suggest running `tsc --noEmit` and enabling `no-use-before-define` in ESLint to catch this class of bug automatically.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The /pair screen fix (removal of `void persistMember`) is verified end-to-end. Session host player.member_id now equals the identified member's Member ID (from Members Google Sheet). The pair-round row-title regression uses disambiguateNames which extends last names character-by-character when first names collide — 'Alex Nguyen' + 'Alex Newman' correctly displays 'Alex Ng' and 'Alex Ne'.
rca_of_issue: Root cause of the crash introduced during the fix: main agent left a leftover `void persistMember;` statement on line 56 that referenced `const persistMember` declared two lines later on line 58. Const/let are hoisted but in the temporal dead zone until initialization, so evaluating the identifier throws ReferenceError, unmounting the component tree via the error boundary. Repro: navigate to /pair (with or without identity) — screen would show LogBox 'Uncaught Error: Cannot access persistMember before initialization'. Mitigation applied: deleted the 3 unused lines. Post-fix repro confirms both identity-missing and identity-present states render correctly.
